reconnecting.label: Reconnecting...
reconnecting.hint: This page loaded fine, so the panel server is reachable — only this live-update connection is having trouble. If it keeps happening and the panel runs behind a reverse proxy (nginx, Apache, Caddy, etc.), ask whoever manages it to confirm WebSocket upgrades are forwarded.

disconnected.label: Live Updates Unavailable
disconnected.description: The panel itself is working — you're viewing this page over a working connection. Only the live-update connection couldn't be established.
disconnected.hint: The most common cause is a reverse proxy (nginx, Apache, Caddy, etc.) in front of the panel that isn't forwarding WebSocket upgrade requests. If that matches your setup, ask whoever manages the proxy to confirm it passes through the Upgrade and Connection: upgrade headers.
